newsitem.title: CHINA: China announces 68 key energy projects for 1997.
newsitem.headline: China announces 68 key energy projects for 1997.

text.p: China is determined to highlight build-up of the energy sector this year by adding 68 energy projects to the list of major national construction plans for 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Energy projects make up more than half of a list of 129 key national construction projects for 1997 set by the State Planning Commission.
Of the 68 projects, 19 involve coal, six are related to petroleum development, 35 are in power construction, and eight are water control projects.

The six petroleum development projects are development of China's largest Daqing Oilfield, exploration at the Liaohe oilfield, development of the Shengli field in eastern Shandong province, development of the Karamay field in western Xinjiang and oil exploration at the Tarim basin in Xinjiang as well as development of the Changqing Oilfield in the provinces of Shaanxi, Gansu and Ningxia, Xinhua said.
It gave no more details of the projects.
